# Business Portfolio

**[EAP Home](../README.md)**

---

> This directory contains business domain documentation for Gainwell's product and service portfolio. Each product includes business domain breakdowns, capability models, process flows, and value streams that define **what the business does** at a high level. This is the business architecture layer - decomposing products into their constituent business domains and capabilities.

[business-portfolio/README.md#10-business-portfolio-overview]

## 1.0 Business Portfolio Overview

<!-- synthesia-video-url: https://share.synthesia.io/a67153d1-3648-4598-aa9a-0059d3d61539 | ../assets/images/synthesia/business-thumbnail.png -->

Gainwell Technologies delivers comprehensive healthcare and human services solutions that support programs in all 50 states, impacting over 72 million Medicaid enrollees and millions of human services beneficiaries. The business portfolio is organized into **10 core solution areas**. This section provides the **business domain view** of each product - describing the business capabilities, processes, and domains that comprise each solution.
page_texts.4:
[business-portfolio/README.md#purpose-of-business-portfolio]

### Purpose of Business Portfolio

This portfolio serves as the **business architecture layer** that:

- **Decomposes products into business domains**: Breaking down each product into its constituent business capabilities and domains
- **Documents business capabilities**: Defining what business functions each product provides
- **Maps business processes**: High-level process flows and BPMN diagrams showing how business operates
- **Defines value streams**: End-to-end value delivery from business perspective
- **Identifies business stakeholders**: Key business roles and stakeholders for each domain

page_texts.8:
[business-portfolio/README.md#purpose]

### Purpose

Each product is decomposed into **business domains** - distinct areas of business capability that represent what the business does. These domains are technology-agnostic and focus on business functions, processes, and capabilities.
page_texts.9:
[business-portfolio/README.md#standard-business-domain-components]

### Standard Business Domain Components

Each business domain should include:

```text
[product-line]/
├── README.md                               # Product overview and business summary
├── business-abstract.md                    # Executive summary & business value proposition
├── domains/                                # Business domain breakdown
│   ├── README.md                           # Domain portfolio overview
│   └── [domain-name]/                      # Individual business domains
│       ├── domain-overview.md              # Business domain scope and purpose
│       ├── business-capabilities.md        # Capability model and breakdown
│       ├── processes/                      # Business process documentation
│       │   ├── README.md                   # Process overview
│       │   ├── bpmn-diagrams/              # BPMN business process models
│       │   └── process-descriptions.md     # Narrative process descriptions
│       ├── stakeholders.md                 # Business stakeholder analysis
│       └── domain-relationships.md         # Inter-domain business relationships
├── value-streams/                          # End-to-end business value delivery
│   ├── README.md                           # Value stream portfolio
│   └── [value-stream-name].md              # Individual value streams
└── business-strategy/                      # Business strategic positioning
    ├── product-strategy.md                 # Business strategic direction
    ├── market-positioning.md               # Market and competitive analysis
    └── business-outcomes.md                # Expected business outcomes and metrics
```
page_texts.10:
[business-portfolio/README.md#what-belongs-here-business-architecture]

### What Belongs Here (Business Architecture)

- **Business Capabilities**: What business functions the product provides
- **Business Processes**: How business work flows (BPMN diagrams, process narratives)
- **Business Domains**: Logical groupings of related business capabilities
- **Value Streams**: End-to-end business value delivery
- **Business Stakeholders**: Roles, responsibilities, and relationships
- **Business Rules**: High-level business logic and constraints
- **Business Outcomes**: KPIs, metrics, and success criteria
page_texts.11:
[business-portfolio/README.md#scope-boundaries]

### Scope Boundaries

**This Business Portfolio documents what the business does** - capabilities, processes, and domains. Technical implementation details (applications, data models, infrastructure, security controls) are maintained in product-specific repositories.

[business-portfolio/README.md#quality-standards]

#### Quality Standards

- **Consistency**: All products follow identical business documentation structure
- **Completeness**: All required business components documented
- **Currency**: Business documentation reviewed and updated as business evolves
- **Accuracy**: Business validation required for all business content
- **Accessibility**: Business content optimized for business stakeholder audiences
page_texts.42:
[business-portfolio/README.md#review-process]

#### Review Process

1. **Business Validation** - Product and domain business owners review for accuracy
2. **Business Architecture Review** - Business architects review for capability alignment
3. **Stakeholder Review** - Business stakeholders review for completeness
4. **EA Integration Review** - EA team reviews for cross-domain integration
5. **Publication Approval** - Business architecture leadership approves publication

page_texts.53:
[business-portfolio/README.md#content-creation-guidelines]

### Content Creation Guidelines

1. **Use Standard Templates**: Follow [shared templates](../resources/work-templates/README.md) for consistency
2. **Validate Business Content**: Ensure business accuracy with domain business owners
3. **Maintain Business Focus**: Keep content focused on business architecture
4. **Follow BPMN Standards**: Use standard BPMN 2.0 notation for all business process diagrams
5. **Document Business Stakeholders**: Include comprehensive business stakeholder analysis
6. **Reference Product Repos**: Link to product-specific repositories for technical implementation details
page_texts.54:
[business-portfolio/README.md#submission-process]

### Submission Process

1. **Create Feature Branch**: Use descriptive branch names for business content updates
2. **Follow Structure**: Ensure all required business components included
3. **Validate Business Content**: Business domain owners review before submission
4. **Submit Pull Request**: Include detailed description of business changes
5. **Address Review Feedback**: Respond to all business review comments

For detailed contribution guidelines, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../foundation/CONTRIBUTING.md).
